x-draft: ADR-0027 (proposed): an interface definition as a standalone record (follow-up 3); not frozen, may change before acceptance
title: Interface definition
description: One interface a module owns (docs/modules.md, 'Interfaces: one owner'): id, version, kind, the item schema (a JSON Schema in the owner, or a shipped schema id), and whether it is a gate. Defined once, in the owner's manifest (its interfaces: entries have exactly this shape); a provider references it, never redefines it. The rules a schema cannot state (one owner per id across every manifest, a gate interface owned by a consumer that never provides it, the schema's $id in the owner's namespace) are in homelabnext.modules.rules.

kind.description: object-prefix: objects under a prefix of an object-store instance; event: an event type; lake-table: a table others read; service: a registry service's API.

schema.description: The JSON Schema of one item (a .json file), in this (the owning) module; the loader reads it as a JSON Schema whose $id is in .../modules/<owner>/.

gate.description: A gate interface: the consumer's gate validates every item (publishable-output, sample-handoff), so the consumer owns it. The owner of a gate interface consumes it (requires or prefers it) and never provides it: a producer cannot define what its own output is checked against.

contract_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of a contract: met by the same major and an equal or higher minor.

format.description: An interchange format at a boundary: ocsf, sigma, cloudevents, action-request, sql, s3, openai-compatible, markdown-records, stix, sarif, ics.

version.description: The format's own version (ocsf 1.3.0, cloudevents 1.0, the S3 API 2006-03-01).

classes.description: The subset in use (OCSF classes, event types).

format_ref.description: A neutral format at a boundary: the conformance suite checks field meanings in it.

interface_id.description: An inter-module interface, named by what it carries; exactly one module (or the core) defines each id and version.

schema_id.description: The $id of a shipped schema (an event type such as events/case.opened/1.0, an OCSF class, ids/logical-id/1.0).
